newsitem.title: USA: Nortech, Metheus sign technology pact.
newsitem.headline: Nortech, Metheus sign technology pact.

text.p: Nortech Systems Inc said Tuesday it signed a technology partnership agreement with Metheus Corp.
The two will share complementary products and services in order to expand their business opportunities in medical imaging and other markets.
Nortech said the alliance is based on its high resolution monitors and Metheus' high resolution graphics controllers.
Nortech manufactures wire harnesses and cable assemblies. Metheus, based in Beaverton, Ore., designs and manufactures high resolution display controllers.
